description: This file implements a mock version of the WebKit layout test driver (DRT) for testing purposes, emulating the behavior of a real DRT, including handling test inputs, generating outputs, and managing environment setup.

classes.name: MockDRTPort
classes.description: A mock port class that emulates a real port, overriding driver creation and environment setup for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockDRT
classes.description: A mock driver test runner that simulates running layout tests, processing test inputs, and generating outputs for testing automation.
